values: 141 features. Shared accounting foundation plus industry-specific capabilities. Filter by Module or Applies to.
Cyber means cybersecurity / IT services. Insurance carriers need specialist design. Tax and reporting rules depend on jurisdiction.
Manage multiple businesses, branches and cost centers.
Set accounting calendars, opening dates and period locks.
Record foreign-currency transactions and exchange differences.
Import opening account, customer, supplier, stock and asset balances.
Configure invoice and voucher numbering by company and document type.
Create account groups and map accounts to financial statements.
Maintain customer details, credit terms, contacts and tax identifiers.
Maintain supplier details, payment terms and verified bank accounts.
Maintain parties for payroll, advances, expenses and other transactions.
Maintain stock items, non-stock services, units and accounting mappings.
Manage customer, supplier, quantity and date-based prices.
Create balanced accounting entries with narration and attachments.
Record cash and bank movements and allocate them to balances.
Schedule repeat journals and other recurring accounting documents.
Record accrued income or costs and reverse them when appropriate.
Spread prepaid costs and advance income over approved periods.
Correct transactions while retaining the original document history.
Allocate shared income or costs to branches, departments and projects.
Record realized exchange differences and period-end revaluations.
Create quotations and convert accepted orders into invoices.
Issue item, service and recurring invoices with taxes and discounts.
Invoice projects or contracts at agreed stages.
Track advance receipts and apply them to later invoices.
Allocate receipts, track overpayments and issue approved refunds.
Control customer exposure and approve exceptions.
Track overdue invoices, collection tasks and payment reminders.
Manage short payments, disputes, provisions and approved write-offs.
Let customers view invoices, statements and payment status securely.
Request, approve and track purchases and commitments.
Capture bills and validate supplier, tax, amount and duplicate references.
Match bills to orders and accepted goods or services.
Track advance payments and adjust them against bills.
Account for returns, rebates and supplier credit adjustments.
Select approved bills for payment based on due dates and cash availability.
Submit approved payments and track rejection or settlement.
Compare supplier statements with bills, payments and credits.
Allow authorized suppliers to submit bills and see payment status.
Manage company bank accounts, cash drawers and custodians.
Import statements or connect supported bank feeds.
Match bank entries to books and resolve differences.
Show book and bank-reported balances separately with refresh times.
Manage floats, cash expenses and replenishment.
Reconcile collections, processing fees, refunds and payouts.
Track disputed payments, evidence deadlines and outcomes.
Forecast cash using expected receipts, payments and commitments.
Track borrowing balances, interest accruals and repayment schedules.
Track stock movements and balances by location.
Track lot, serial and expiry details where required.
Reconcile physical stock and approve differences.
Move inventory between locations and track in-transit quantities.
Support selected costing methods and reconcile stock value to accounts.
Allocate freight and other eligible acquisition costs to purchases.
Cost materials and conversion inputs against finished output.
Account for damaged, obsolete, expired or wasted inventory.
Record approved asset costs, categories, location and ownership.
Calculate and post depreciation using approved methods and useful lives.
Track capital projects until assets are ready for use.
Track custodians, location changes and physical checks.
Account for sales, scrapping and approved asset value adjustments.
Maintain lease payment and accounting schedules under the selected policy.
Submit receipts and approve employee reimbursements.
Import approved payroll and reconcile salary and deduction payables.
Optional payroll engine with country-specific pay and deduction rules.
Configure applicable taxes, exemptions and effective dates by jurisdiction.
Track eligible purchase taxes and reconcile differences.
Calculate and track configured deductions and remittances.
Support required invoice submissions through local authority/provider interfaces.
Prepare jurisdiction-specific reports and reconcile them to books.
Retain documents and accounting history under approved local policies.
View account movements, vouchers and running balances.
Report opening balances, debits, credits and closing balances.
Report income, expenses and profit by company, branch and period.
Report assets, liabilities and equity at a selected date.
Report operating, investing and financing cash movements.
Show outstanding balances by party, due date and aging band.
Maintain approved plans and compare them with actual results.
Analyze revenue, direct costs and allocated costs by business unit.
Combine company results and eliminate intercompany balances and transactions.
Match balances and transactions between group companies.
Create role-based views with filters, drilldowns and exports.
Assign reconciliations and close tasks, collect approvals and lock periods.
Control view, create, edit, approve, post and export access.
Limit records and reports to each user’s authorized scope.
Set approval limits, escalation and temporary delegation.
Prevent incompatible actions such as preparing and approving the same payment.
Track changes, approvals, reversals and sensitive exports.
Store and retrieve invoices, receipts and supporting evidence.
Flag duplicate bills, unbalanced entries and unresolved exceptions.
Import legacy data with mappings, validation and reconciliation totals.
Connect POS, payroll, CRM, inventory, banks and other business systems.
Track failed imports and retries without duplicate accounting postings.
Support MFA, session revocation and optional single sign-on.
Keep each customer organization’s records isolated in a shared service.
Back up accounting data and verify recovery of records and attachments.
Optional OCR to extract bill and receipt data for human review.
Support mobile approvals, expense capture and selected reports.
Support applicable languages, date formats, currencies and local document layouts.
Define and test performance, uptime and recovery targets.
Manage customer plans, licenses and product subscription billing.
Post outlet sales, tenders, discounts, taxes and refunds once per source transaction.
Reconcile shift collections, shortages and bank deposits.
Reconcile delivery orders, commissions, deductions and payouts.
Compare recipe-based consumption with actual stock usage and waste.
Cost production batches and transfers to restaurant outlets.
Analyze contribution by item, outlet and sales channel.
Track collections, liabilities and distributions under approved local policy.
Track issuance, redemption and related accounting balances.
Calculate contract-based royalties and fees when franchise outlets exist.
Track transactions by property, building, unit, owner and tenant.
Generate rent schedules with contract-based increases and concessions.
Track security deposits, deductions and refunds separately from rent income.
Allocate common-area, utility and other recoverable costs.
Track unpaid rent, collections and tenant account balances.
Separate client funds and produce owner statements and payouts where applicable.
Track land, development and construction costs by project and phase.
Track buyer advances, progress billings and approved revenue treatment.
Report rent, vacancy-related revenue gaps, operating costs and property returns.
Track revenue and costs by client, contract and engagement.
Convert approved time and expenses into customer invoices.
Bill recurring managed services, subscriptions and support contracts.
Link fixed-price invoices to approved delivery or acceptance milestones.
Track earned but unbilled work and advance billing under approved policies.
Allocate cloud, software and reseller costs to customers and projects.
Match subcontractor costs and accruals to client engagements.
Account for approved SLA credits, rebates and scope changes.
Compare contract revenue, staff cost, third-party costs and margin.
Link transactions to policies, insurers, customers and endorsements.
Track premiums collected and amounts payable to insurers.
Maintain separate client-fund ledgers and reconciliations where required.
Calculate commissions, reversals and adjustments from contract terms.
Match premiums, commissions and settlements to insurer statements.
Account for policy cancellation adjustments and returned premiums.
Track approved agent or sub-broker commissions and payouts.
Import approved policy, premium and claim accounting events.
Support applicable insurance-accounting models using specialist-approved calculations.
Import actuarial estimates and reconcile claim reserve movements.
Track ceded premiums, recoveries, commissions and counterparty balances.
Track investment income, valuations and accounting entries under the selected policy.
Map validated subledger and general-ledger data to required local returns.
